ledger_accounts_owner_check.name: ledger_accounts_owner_check
ledger_accounts_owner_check.value:
("operational"."ledger_accounts"."kind" in ('patient_receivable', 'patient_credit')) = ("operational"."ledger_accounts"."patient_id" is not null)
        and ("operational"."ledger_accounts"."kind" = 'processor_clearing') = ("operational"."ledger_accounts"."payment_account_id" is not null)
        and ("operational"."ledger_accounts"."kind" = 'pharmacy_payable') = ("operational"."ledger_accounts"."partner_pharmacy_id" is not null)

payment_accounts_lifecycle_check.name: payment_accounts_lifecycle_check
payment_accounts_lifecycle_check.value:
("operational"."payment_accounts"."status" = 'closed') = ("operational"."payment_accounts"."closed_at" is not null)
        and ("operational"."payment_accounts"."status" <> 'active' or "operational"."payment_accounts"."activated_at" is not null)
        and (not "operational"."payment_accounts"."is_default" or "operational"."payment_accounts"."status" = 'active')

price_fees_medicine_check.name: price_fees_medicine_check
price_fees_medicine_check.value:
("operational"."price_fees"."fee_kind" = 'medicine') = ("operational"."price_fees"."product_id" is not null)
        and ("operational"."price_fees"."fee_kind" = 'medicine') = ("operational"."price_fees"."pharmacy_share_cents" is not null)
        and ("operational"."price_fees"."fee_kind" <> 'medicine' or "operational"."price_fees"."billing_model" = 'bundled')
        and ("operational"."price_fees"."pharmacy_share_cents" is null or "operational"."price_fees"."pharmacy_share_cents" between 0 and "operational"."price_fees"."amount_cents")

prices_interval_check.name: prices_interval_check
prices_interval_check.value: "operational"."prices"."interval_count" between 1 and (case "operational"."prices"."interval_unit" when 'week' then 52 else 12 end)

prices_lifecycle_check.name: prices_lifecycle_check
prices_lifecycle_check.value:
("operational"."prices"."status" = 'draft') = ("operational"."prices"."published_at" is null)
        and ("operational"."prices"."status" = 'retired') = ("operational"."prices"."retired_at" is not null)
        and ("operational"."prices"."replaces_price_id" is null) = ("operational"."prices"."version" = 1)

subscriptions_lifecycle_check.name: subscriptions_lifecycle_check
subscriptions_lifecycle_check.value:
("operational"."subscriptions"."status" = 'pending') = ("operational"."subscriptions"."activated_at" is null and "operational"."subscriptions"."status" <> 'cancelled')
        and ("operational"."subscriptions"."status" not in ('active', 'paused')
          or ("operational"."subscriptions"."current_period_starts_on" is not null and "operational"."subscriptions"."current_period_ends_on" is not null and "operational"."subscriptions"."next_period_starts_on" is not null))
        and ("operational"."subscriptions"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("operational"."subscriptions"."cancelled_at" is not null)
        and ("operational"."subscriptions"."status" = 'cancelled' or "operational"."subscriptions"."cancels_at_period_end") = ("operational"."subscriptions"."cancel_reason" is not null)
        and (not "operational"."subscriptions"."cancels_at_period_end" or "operational"."subscriptions"."status" in ('active', 'paused'))
        and ("operational"."subscriptions"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("operational"."subscriptions"."ended_on" is not null)
        and ("operational"."subscriptions"."current_period_ends_on" > "operational"."subscriptions"."current_period_starts_on") is not false
        and ("operational"."subscriptions"."next_period_starts_on" >= "operational"."subscriptions"."current_period_ends_on") is not false
        and ("operational"."subscriptions"."next_period_starts_on" <= "operational"."subscriptions"."current_period_ends_on" + interval '3 months') is not false
